description: This file defines wrapper functions for stream processing in an AI agent context, including cache management, header resolution, and payload normalization, specifically tailored for openrouter and kilocode providers.

methods.name: resolveKilocodeAppHeaders
methods.description: Resolves Kilocode application headers based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: mapThinkingLevelToOpenRouterReasoningEffort
methods.description: Maps a ThinkLevel to a string representing reasoning effort.

methods.name: normalizeProxyReasoningPayload
methods.description: Normalizes the reasoning payload based on thinking level, removing or setting reasoning effort.

methods.name: createOpenRouterSystemCacheWrapper
methods.description: Creates a wrapper for stream functions that manages cache markers for OpenRouter models.

methods.name: createOpenRouterWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper that adds headers and normalizes reasoning payloads for OpenRouter.

methods.name: isProxyReasoningUnsupported
methods.description: Checks if proxy reasoning is unsupported for a given model ID.

methods.name: createKilocodeWrapper
methods.description: Creates a stream wrapper for Kilocode with payload normalization.
